title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Request for Investigation of Payment Status)
(1) Any person wishing to make a request under Article 6(2) of the Act shall submit a payment status verification request form, including the date and amount of payment, to the post office. However, if the post office can verify the payment status of the postal money order in question, the submission of the payment status verification request form may be omitted. <Amended July 8, 2016>
(2) Upon receiving a request under Article 1(1), the post office shall investigate the payment status of the postal money order and notify the requester of the results.
(3) The person making a request under Article 1(1) shall pay the fee as determined and announced by the Minister of the Ministry of Science and Technology Information and Communication. <Amended July 31, 1998, March 3, 2008, March 24, 2013, July 26, 2017>
